name: June X Web — Independent Dashboard Edition
description: Independent web-managed multi-session WhatsApp bot platform (no June X family, no external session server). Public QR/code pairing at / and protected dev room at /dev, fully self-contained.

JUNE_PLATFORM.description: Enable the Dashboard Edition web platform

JUNE_SESSIONS.description: Independent session registry (self-contained, no external server). Example: [{"sessionId":"JTEST~<base64>","phone":"2348..."}] or [] for empty fleet. Each entry auto-boots isolated bot.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Long, unique password for the /dev control room

PLATFORM_MAX_BOTS.description: Shared QR and pairing-code fleet capacity

PLATFORM_CREATES_PER_HOUR.description: Public bot creations allowed per IP each hour

PLATFORM_SLOT_TTL_MIN.description: Public pairing slot lifetime in minutes
